traceability.notes: The story docs/stories/007.0-DEV-ERROR-REPORTING.story.md defines cross-rule error message behavior: specific and actionable messages, consistent templates and placeholders, appropriate severities, and robust error handling. The implementation aligns with this in all referenced rules: require-story-annotation, require-req-annotation, require-branch-annotation, valid-annotation-format, valid-story-reference, and valid-req-reference. Each rule exposes structured messages through meta.messages with documented placeholders; helper utilities ensure that location and contextual data (function names, paths, requirement IDs, underlying fs errors) are included; and plugin configs map rule severities according to the story. Multiple test suites explicitly reference this story and its REQ-ERROR-* requirements and verify both message content and data wiring. All these tests pass, providing strong evidence that every acceptance criterion and listed requirement in this story is fully implemented and functioning as specified.
